rubrics.justification: Generally recognizes a good-quality blastocyst with plausible ICM/TE comments, but is somewhat uncertain/inconsistent on expansion stage and discusses possible collapse/hatching without clear image support; also overfocuses on Gardner nomenclature ambiguity rather than image-grounded morphology.

Integrates age, male factor diagnosis, ovarian reserve, BMI, endometrial thickness, prior cycle history, and lifestyle factors well, with appropriate emphasis on the borderline 7 mm lining as the main non-embryo limitation.

Reasoning is mostly logical and internally consistent, linking favorable age/morphology with modest downward adjustment for lining and BMI; minor inconsistency remains around stage 3 vs 4 interpretation and exact prognosis framing.

Largely aligned with standard IVF practice and Gardner grading principles, appropriately cautious about untested embryos and selective use of PGT-A; minor deviations include somewhat speculative comments on receptivity adjuncts and stage-label discussion.

Provides practical next steps for proceeding with transfer, optimizing luteal/endometrial factors, lifestyle modification, and future workup if unsuccessful; recommendations are useful though not highly protocol-specific.
